name: What are the signs that my water heater needs maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my water heater needs maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs can indicate your water heater needs attention. These include unusual noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, a noticeable decrease in hot water supply, water that smells metallic or rusty, or visible leaks around the unit's base. If you experience any of these issues, it's best to contact a professional for an inspection. Ignoring these signs can lead to more costly repairs or even premature unit replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include strange noises, reduced hot water, discolored water, or leaks. Address these promptly to prevent further damage.
